name: annu-rev-food
description: Author-guideline skill for Annual Review of Food Science and Technology (Annual Reviews, ISSN 1941-1413). Use to format or check an invited review for this journal — review structure, author–date Annual Reviews references, and figure specs. Triggers: submit to Annual Review of Food Science and Technology, Annual Reviews guidelines, invited food review formatting. Also fires when the user wants to publish on/in this journal, format a manuscript for it, or match its reference/citation style.
